column1: # Prewarm seed list (shipped in the app, next to shader_map.tsv). Rows: S<TAB>shader key<TAB>stage / R<TAB>render pipeline key (pso_skey hex) / C<TAB>compute shader key / M<TAB>task shader key or -<TAB>native task / mesh pipeline key (pso_skey hex: the mesh shader in the vertex place).

# Recorded by play on an iPhone 19,4 (a Duo foldable, applegpu_g19p, iOS 27.3 beta) with update 1.8.0 (v917504) on 2026-11-09, from an empty list: the device's own pso_user.tsv over about 15 launches, each the boot, the title, the menus into a Grand Prix and Mario Bros. Circuit with 24 racers, and 5 to 8 minutes of driving. In first-use order; do not sort.

# 3,316 of the R rows were written by a host from before the high attributes (attr_hi) and are padded here with zeros to the current key size, which is how pso_skey_parse reads them. 21 of the 5,689 shader keys and 7 of the 150 compute keys are 1.8.0's only: the base game's shader map does not have them, and they are dropped at load there.
